request.spec:
A claim can be commented (a text entry and a button on the claim; an empty comment is refused
with an error on the claim). Each comment is kept with the user who wrote it and the sheet's today
when it was written, shown on the claim in order as <user> on <date>: <text>, and written as
COMMENT_ADDED, naming the claim like every claim line and ending text=<text>. A viewer, an archived
sheet and the as-of view refuse it like any change.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A claim can be commented (a text entry and a button on the claim; an empty comment is refused
with an error on the claim). Each comment is kept with the user who wrote it and the sheet's today
when it was written, shown on the claim in order as <user> on <date>: <text>, and written as

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit

AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Claims can now be commented, and all 4 acceptance tests pass on `bin/e2e`.

**What it does**
- Each claim row has a comment box and an "Add comment" button.
- Comments are listed on the claim in the order they were written, each as `<user> on <date>: <text>`, using the sheet's today when it was written.
- A blank comment is refused with the claim's error message, and nothing is saved.
- Each comment writes a `COMMENT_ADDED` audit line in the same format as the other claim lines, ending `text=<text>`.
- Comments are allowed on a claim in any status, including settled.
- Viewers, archived sheets and the as-of view are refused automatically by the app's existing request guards; this needed no new code.

**Changes**
- **Stored data:** a new table, `V58__claim_comment.sql`, and a `ClaimComment` entity attached to `Claim` in the same way as its status log.
- **Server:**
  - `ClaimService.comment` trims the text, refuses it if empty, saves it and writes the audit line.
  - The new endpoint is `POST /claims/{id}/comments`.
  - `ClaimView` now includes the comments. In the as-of view it shows only those written on or before that day.
- **Front end:** the `Claim` type gains `comments`, there is a new `Claims.comment` call, and `person-claims.ts` gets the comment list, box, button and error messages. The comment box clears after a successful save.

**Behaviours the request didn't specify**
- Comments stay on the original claim when it is split; the new claim starts with none.
- Comments are not editable or deletable.
